description.value: Memphis Blues BBQ House is a multi-award-winning Southern BBQ restaurant on downtown Vancouver's Robson Street, recognized by Georgia Straight, Vancouver Magazine, and Food Network Canada for its applewood-smoked, low-and-slow meats cooked on-site daily. Part of a regional chain with locations across BC and Alberta, the Robson location offers both indoor and outdoor seating and serves hearty portions suited to refueling after a long day in the saddle. Catering for groups up to 800 is also available.
